info.name: S3 Export API — Approach A (Streaming ZIP)
info.description:
Endpoints for the streaming-zip approach. The ZIP is built on the fly and streamed directly to S3 via S3 multipart upload while the client uploads files. A per-session write lock serialises writes to the single open ZipArchive.

## Variables
- `baseUrl` — e.g. `http://localhost:5000`
- `userId` — owner of the export (used in the S3 key)
- `exportId` — set automatically from the response of `Start export`
- `fileUploadId` — set automatically from the response of `Start multipart file`
- `fileName` — name of the file being uploaded

## Typical flow
1. Start export → captures `exportId`
2. Upload small file (raw body) — repeat for each small file
3. Start multipart file → captures `fileUploadId`
4. Upload part — repeat for each part of the same file (must be sequential)
5. Complete multipart file (releases the per-session write lock)
6. Complete export → returns the final S3 URL

Use `Abort export` to discard an in-progress export.

request.description: Initiates an S3 multipart upload and creates an in-memory ZipArchive bound to it. Returns `exportId`.

body.description: Select a local file in the Body tab — its bytes are streamed as the request body.

request.description: Streams the raw request body into a new entry in the export ZIP. Acquires and releases the per-session write lock around the copy.
Acquires the session write lock and opens a new ZIP entry. The lock is held until `complete multipart file`.

body.description: Select the next chunk of the file. Parts are appended to the open zip entry in arrival order, so they MUST be sent sequentially.

request.description: Closes the ZIP entry stream and releases the per-session write lock so other files can be uploaded.
Disposes the ZipArchive (writes the central directory), completes the S3 multipart upload, persists the URL, and returns `s3Url`.
Disposes the session and aborts the underlying S3 multipart upload. Returns 204.
